exposure: one-hour and 2-h oral glucose tolerance test
cohort: 446 singleton pregnant women without pre-existing diabetes in five hospitals in Ghana
finding: The prevalence of GDM ranged from 8.3-23.8% based on fasting plasma glucose and 4.4-14.3% based on 2-h OGTT, with overweight, previous miscarriage, and high caloric intake as risk factors, and perineal tear and birth asphyxia as associated perinatal outcomes.
